answer: A Sybil-resistant economy ties voting weight to locked stake, not identity count, and slashes it on double-attestation. A raven agent forked into a thousand copies still casts one weight, since influence equals locked capital. Honest attestations form a beacon of trust that grows with age and bond, while a reef of fake accounts starts at zero reputation and no collateral. To sway a vote an attacker must lock capital proportional to the influence sought, and equivocation burns it outright. Cost scales with attack size and is forfeited on failure, so minting identities is pointless.
